Title: Permanent In-Memory Lock Suppresses Retries
Root Cause: recordingAttemptedRooms was a permanent Set that never cleared on quota error
Business Impact: Calls could not retry recording upon answer
Proposed Fix: Replaced with in-flight lock and 3-attempt retry map

Title: Terminal Status NOT_AVAILABLE Blocks Retry
Root Cause: Line 476 aborted if recordingStatus was NOT_AVAILABLE
Business Impact: Customer answer after transient failure could not start recording
Proposed Fix: Allow retry on active calls if attempts < 3

Title: Missing Egress ID Validation in LivekitService
Root Cause: startRoomRecording returned empty string without throwing error
Proposed Fix: Validate non-empty egressId and throw explicit error

Title: Missing BullMQ Processor for sales_queue
Root Cause: BullModule registers sales_queue but no @Processor('sales_queue') exists
Business Impact: Jobs pushed to sales_queue stall indefinitely in Redis

Title: ERP Financial & HR Modules Not Implemented
Root Cause: Models exist in schema but no backend APIs or DB records exist
Business Impact: Users see static mock timelines or empty screens
Proposed Fix: Hide/disable ERP navigation links during CRM pilot

Title: Disconnected UI Buttons on Automation & Settings
Root Cause: Over 60 buttons update React state without calling backend APIs
Business Impact: User config changes lost on page refresh
Proposed Fix: Implement REST persistence or disable mock toggles

Title: Third-Party Vulnerabilities in npm Dependencies
Business Impact: Potential prototype pollution / SSRF in third-party code
Proposed Fix: Execute npm audit fix and update affected packages
